title: An xAPI course on getting the most out of agents, built by the workflow it teaches
description: I'd like to build an xAPI-compliant course with the workflow I have: one I can put on our LMS for people to work through, teaching them how to get the most out of agents. We're an e-learning company with a lot of learning designers, and I think the workflow could build learning courses as code just as well as it builds software, because courses are generally made of code. Not the presentation turned into a course: a course as well, that people can go through. (Ross, 2026-10-15, in the presentation repo's session; log in docs/conversations/2026-10-15-where-the-course-starts.md.)
notes:
PROBLEM
An xAPI course on the company's LMS teaching how to get the most out of agents, built by the workflow it teaches. Content settled 2026-10-15 (docs/course/, C1-C17); design first pass at https://claude.ai/artifact/My3Z79MHvyCBktJsMfAggM (source in docs/design/2026-10-15-first-pass/). The brief now covers implementation: the LMS launch and package, the statements, the xAPI library, the authoring format, resume.

FOUND (2026-10-15)
- The LMS needs xAPI 1.0.2 (Ross); a later version did not work. The spec (xAPI-Communication §3.3) says an LRS MUST accept any version header starting with "1.0.", so a client pinned to 1.0.2 is valid against every 1.0.x LRS.
- Launch: the classic "TinCan" launch opens the course's launch page with endpoint, auth and actor in the query string, and activity_id and registration where the LMS supplies them; the package is a zip with tincan.xml at the root naming the activity id and the launch file. cmi5 launches differently (a fetch URL for the token).
- Library: xAPI.js (@xapi/xapi, TypeScript) has a version option on the constructor, XAPI.getTinCanLaunchData() to read the launch query string, sendStatement, and a fetch adapter. TinCanJS (Rustici) does the same, older and untyped, with 1.0.2 in its compatibility table.
- The State API exists in 1.0.x for per-learner resume data keyed by activity, agent and registration.

DECISIONS
D1-D17: the content decisions C1-C17 in docs/course/README.md §9, adopted with the same numbers (the C numbers are the D numbers).

OPEN (ranked)
1. Launch and package: TinCan launch + tincan.xml zip, version header 1.0.2 (recommended) vs cmi5; confirm the LMS imports a tincan.xml zip and whether Ross can get an LRS endpoint to test against.
2. Statements the LMS needs: completed with completion and a scaled score on the course activity (recommended), and whether the LMS needs passed/failed to show completion.
3. Library and sending: @xapi/xapi with fetch adapter and version "1.0.2" behind a small Tracker interface (recommended) vs TinCanJS; a non-blocking queue with one retry.
4. Authoring format: one YAML file per module validated by a schema at build time (recommended) vs Markdown vs JSON.
5. Resume: xAPI State API with localStorage fallback (recommended) vs localStorage only.
Later: whether Ross's name appears on the scenario/home (C10); module length limits the LMS imposes.

ROUNDS
- 2026-10-15 round 1: questions 1-5 above asked, with recommendations. Answers pending.
